title: Anthropic IPO prospectus reveals surging growth and infrastructure costs
factual_summary: Reuters reports Anthropic had nearly $4.6 billion of 2025 revenue, more than $8 billion of operating losses, $7.33 billion of compute and infrastructure expense, and $518 billion of future cloud, compute and infrastructure obligations.

thesis.statement: A public Anthropic could become a direct public-market valuation benchmark for frontier AI while exposing the capital intensity of model growth.

title: AMD to acquire World Labs for $8.2 billion in physical AI push
factual_summary: AMD announced an $8.2 billion all-stock acquisition of World Labs, whose spatial-intelligence models target robotics, simulation and design; Fei-Fei Li is expected to join AMD as chief scientist.

thesis.statement: AMD is expanding beyond GPU supply toward models, software and workload insight for physical AI.

title: Korean exports signal continued strength in AI semiconductor demand
factual_summary: A Reuters poll forecasts South Korean exports up 62.0% year on year in September; semiconductor exports rose 259.4% in the first twenty days of the month amid strong AI investment demand.

thesis.statement: Korean trade data provide independent industrial confirmation that AI investment continues to transmit into semiconductor volumes.

title: Roche starts building autonomous AI-driven laboratories
factual_summary: Roche said it has begun building autonomous AI-driven labs; 40% of tracked pipeline decisions from Q4 2025 through Q2 2026 had an AI or computational contribution, and Target Nexus is intended to contribute to 80% of research portfolio decisions by end-2026.

thesis.statement: Pharma AI is moving from analytical assistance toward automated experimental loops integrating proprietary data, models and robotics.
